description: See your laptop's charge in bb's sidebar without switching to the menu bar. A battery icon and percentage sit at the right end of the sidebar footer, filled red at 20% or less, yellow up to 50% and green above. A click opens a popup with each device's state and charge, including the phone or tablet you opened bb on when its browser reports a battery. `bb battery status` prints the same reading for terminals and agents. Reads the charge of the machine running the bb server, which must be a Mac; no account or external service.
